title: Cell spec sheet: capacity, charge current, charge temperature, PCM values, size
procedure: get the MYWAY 403450 spec sheet; record it in hardware/vv/evidence/cell_403450.md and in board/cell.json (VER-160); recompute R5, REQ-PRD-03.R, REQ-PRD-04.R and REQ-BAT-02.R from it
pass_limit: capacity; standard charge current >= 295 mA (R5's highest, 242-295 mA); its charge temperature range against the 3.9-48.2 C window TH1 gives at 71737ae (DF-147); OVP/UVP/OCP and the short-circuit delay; its largest length and width with the PCM: 51.6 x 35.6 mm or less fits the tub's pocket at 71737ae with 0.1 mm a side after the print's 0.1 (design_numbers.py cellgap, DEC-27)
needs: the 403450 spec sheet from the AliExpress vendor by email, or a cell sold with a datasheet, a named PCM and a UN38.3 summary (PLAN.md decision DEC-23), 7d (estimate)

title: Cell transport documents (UN38.3 test summary, MSDS)
procedure: ask the cell vendor for the UN38.3 test summary and MSDS of the exact model
pass_limit: both documents in hand for the cell model and lot
needs: UN38.3 summary and MSDS from the cell vendor, 14d (estimate)

title: Docs match the design (stale-doc sweep)
procedure: read README, PLAN, docs/*.md, the pin-review notes and the comments in design.py and placement.py against design.py and case.scad; list each mismatch in an evidence file (F's objection: the comments too)
pass_limit: 0 statements that disagree with design.py, case.scad or a check's output (DEF-21 lists them)
covers: hardware/ref_design/docs/*.md hardware/ref_design/README.md hardware/ref_design/PLAN.md hardware/ref_design/board/design.py hardware/ref_design/case/case.scad hardware/ref_design/board/placement.py

title: Clean-room schematic review by a human who has not seen the notes
procedure: post the schematic PDF to r/PrintedCircuitBoard or EEVblog with no design notes; allow a week
pass_limit: replies read; every point answered in hardware/vv/evidence/cleanroom.md
subsystems: power cell mcu display audio buttons usb_debug

title: Order-day stock, no substitution, pre-orders
procedure: JLC BOM page on order day; confirm RP2354B and L2 pre-ordered or consigned; 'do not substitute' on every line
pass_limit: stock >= quantity x 1.1 + attrition on every line; L2 and RP2354B are the designed parts
needs: RP2354B x35 and L2 (AOTA) x35 pre-ordered or consigned at JLC (both out of stock 2026-10-21), 21d (estimate)
subsystems: power cell mcu display audio buttons usb_debug

title: Release record complete
procedure: hardware/vv/tools/release.py (VER-143) fills hardware/vv/releases/REL-<board>-R<rev>-<phase>.md from releases/TEMPLATE.md; Alex adds the JLC order number and JLC's returned placement file
pass_limit: tag, commit, design baseline, fab zip, BOM and CPL sha256, BOARD_REV, locked BOM, no-substitution list, order options checklist, capability page date, case section, gate output and waivers all filled

title: Real panel lit through a bottom-contact FPC breakout with design.py's J3 map; redraw timed
procedure: before any power, put the FPC into the breakout contacts down (assembly.md section 5 step 6); diode-test to find which header pin is panel 1 (LEDA, forward to 2 and 3) and check continuity among panel 11-32 (GND); record the breakout header pin each panel pin lands on (it must equal 51 minus the FH12 pad number); then wire the dev board by the panel's own pin names (1 LEDA, 2-3 LEDK, 7-9 IM, 10 RESET, 33 SDO, 34 SDA, 36 SCL, 37 D/CX, 38 CSX, 40-42 VDDI/VCI, 11-32 GND); read ID4 (0xD3) on SDO first, and on SDA with a turnaround if nothing answers, recording which pin answered (F-R8); light each cathode pin (LEDK1, LEDK2: three LEDs each) in turn from the bench supply through 47 ohm; then time a full 320 x 480 redraw sent as 18-bit colour at the in-spec clock (20 MHz writes: 184 ms; 18.75 MHz from a 150 MHz clk_peri: 197 ms) and a battle-text update
pass_limit: each cathode pin lights at 20 mA and its voltage at 60 mA is recorded (three LEDs in parallel: one LED's share is not visible); ID4 reads 0x94 0x88 at <= 5 MHz (trc 150 ns allows 6.7 MHz); the recorded breakout-to-panel map equals 51 minus the FH12 pad number for every contact; a colour fill shows no missing line; a full redraw and a text update within REQ-DSP-11's numbers, with no write clock over 20 MHz
needs: ER-TFT035IPS-6 panel, no touch (buydisplay.com, 10d), 0.5 mm 50-pin bottom-contact breakout (7d), an RP2350B dev board (7d)

title: Panel FPC tail thickness and width against the FH12-50S
procedure: calipers (about $15 if not owned) on the stiffened tail at three points
pass_limit: tail 0.30 +-0.05 mm (the panel's drawing: 0.3 +-0.03) and 25.5 +-0.07 mm wide at the contacts; exposed contact length >= 3 mm
needs: calipers (about $15, 2d) and the panel (VER-43)

title: Comb pill resistance on ENIG, on a bare board from the order
procedure: a bare board from the same JLC order (same ENIG bath and mask), on day one before any assembled unit is powered; press a DS Lite pill with a 1 N weight on every contact; DMM ohms (a $2 coupon ordered now is advisory only)
pass_limit: < 1 kohm on every contact, 10 presses each
needs: the 5 bare boards from the JLC order, 14d

title: Comb leakage at 4.2 V, clean and after humidity
procedure: on the same bare board: 4.2 V from the bench supply through the comb into a DMM on volts (10 Mohm input); read the leakage from the divider
pass_limit: >= 100 Mohm (DMM reads <= 0.38 V) clean, after a damp-cloth wipe and after 24 h in a sealed box with a wet sponge
needs: the 5 bare boards from the JLC order, 14d

title: Latch replica on SOT-23 breakouts (disputed: Fable only)
procedure: build Q1, D2, D3, R13-R15, R42, U3 from the real LCSC parts; drive PWR_HOLD from a Pico 2 through a watchdog reset
pass_limit: holds and releases at VSYS 3.5 and 4.2 V; starts with 1 kohm in series with the button
evidence: superseded by VER-33 (latch.py) before the order and VER-70, VER-73, VER-77, VER-78 on unit 1; every latch part reworks on an EVT unit and USB bypasses the latch for bring-up (O-10, F-32); G-ORD-06 needs Alex's waiver W-01

title: Printed case with real parts: fit, screws, caps, panel in the top
procedure: print the released case (VER-173 names its STL hashes, material and slicer profile); fit the board, cell, speaker, silicone, caps and panel; close with the six screws
pass_limit: closes without force; caps 1.85 +-0.2 mm proud and free; panel window aligned within 0.5 mm; nothing rattles; the evidence names the case release hash

title: Cell incoming inspection per lot
procedure: every cell: DMM on the plug (red lead on J2 pin 1 '+'), OCV; the plug latches in a Molex 53261-0271 sample and withdraws only with the latch pressed; one per lot: calipers with its PCM; run before the first cell is plugged (F-R9: the cells take 21 days to arrive)
pass_limit: 100% polarity correct; 100% of plugs latch; OCV 3.6-4.0 V as shipped; length and width with the PCM within the limit cell.json and DEC-27 set (52 x 36 x 4.5 mm, case.scad's worst case, today)
needs: cells (AliExpress, 21d) and one 53261-0271 sample (LCSC, $0.13, 7d)

title: Button force and travel against a genuine DS Lite
procedure: kitchen scale (0.1 g) under the cap, press until the pill closes (DMM continuity); depth gauge or calipers for travel
pass_limit: force within +-30% of the genuine DS Lite measured the same way; travel within +-0.2 mm
needs: a printed case (VER-48) and a genuine DS Lite (owned), 0d

title: Pill-to-comb XY registration measured on the fit kit
procedure: ink the pills, press each button once on the board mock, measure the print against the comb centre (loupe, calipers); at CASE, when the fit kit is printed
pass_limit: every pill print centred within 0.9 mm of its comb centre
needs: a printed fit kit (CASE), 0d

title: BU-0 unpowered resistances to GND (TP1-TP4) and VBUS-VBAT
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0 (DMM)
pass_limit: TP1 8.5-10 kohm (R38 10k in parallel with R14 47k + D3 + R15 100k, about 147 kohm when the meter forward-biases D3, and R43 220k + EN1's internal 285k: 9.19 kohm with D3 on, 9.81 kohm with it off, at 71737ae's values); TP2, TP3 and TP4 > 1 kohm once the caps charge (TP3 above 1 kohm rules out a U2 BAT-to-pad bridge: DF-148); TP1 to TP3 > 10 kohm; none a short

title: BU-0 diode tests VBAT<->VSYS and VBUS<->VSYS
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0 (DMM diode range)
pass_limit: TP3(+) to TP2: one diode drop, 0.4-0.8 V (U2's battery FET's body diode); TP2(+) to TP3: open or above 1.2 V; TP1(+) to TP2: open (U2's input switch blocks both ways); bringup.md step 0 to match (DEF-21)

title: BU-0 cell polarity at J2 before mating
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 0; hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md section 2
pass_limit: red lead on J2 pin 1 '+', checked with a DMM, every cell
needs: cells (AliExpress, 21d)

title: BU-1 USB only, no cell
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 1: first power from the bench supply at 5.0 V with a 100 mA limit through a USB-C breakout, never a wall charger first (DF-101); USB power meter
pass_limit: VBUS 4.75-5.25 V; VSYS 4.30-4.50 V (U2's OUT); 3V3 3.23-3.37 V; input < 60 mA; RP2350 drive appears within 5 s; CHG_PG_N low
needs: USB-C breakout (about $5, 5d)

title: BU-2.1 all 20 buttons read, alone and together
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.1 with the self-test image: 16 through the 74HC165 chain (SR_PL GPIO19, SR_CLK GPIO29 through R65, SR_DATA GPIO30) at 1 MHz, Start and Select on GPIO2, 3, 4, 35
pass_limit: each contact reads pressed when shorted and released otherwise, in the bit order pinmap.md gives; any 4 at once read correctly; both Starts read on GPIO3 and GPIO2

title: BU-2.2/2.3 ADC7 and the charger's status pins
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md steps 2.2-2.3
pass_limit: ADC7 reads; CHG_STAT_N and CHG_PG_N read with the pull-downs off; CHG_PG_N low on USB

title: BU-2.4 SWD through J5 and J7
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.4
pass_limit: probe-rs attaches through J5 and through J7's pads; RTT or USB CDC text from the self-test (no UART connector since 86bf694)

title: BU-2.5 revision strap
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 2.5
pass_limit: REV3..REV0 = BOARD_REV (1) with pull-ups on
evidence: RETIRED in 86bf694: R48-R51 and the revision strap removed; BOARD_REV is on the silkscreen, read in the FAI (VER-109)

title: BU-3.1-3.3 panel init, ID, colour
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display steps 1-3
pass_limit: ID4 (0xD3) = 0x94 0x88 at <= 5 MHz; COLMOD 0x66 (18-bit: the ILI9488 takes no 16-bit colour over SPI); red, green, blue, white fills correct, no missing lines

title: BU-3.4 SPI write speed
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 4
pass_limit: 10 full 320 x 480 frames (461 kB each in 18-bit colour) of a checker pattern at 20 MHz (18.75 MHz from a 150 MHz clk_peri) with 0 corrupted pixels at the far edge; the reads at 6.7 MHz or less (trc 150 ns); the fastest clock that still shows 0 is recorded as an observation, never as the pass band (O-R1: a clock over 20 MHz is out of spec)

title: BU-3.5 backlight current, balance, step response, headroom
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 5; first light with JP2 cut and a DMM on mA across it
pass_limit: 80% duty: 99 +-5 mV on R52 and R53, within 3 mV of each other; at the firmware's highest duty: <= 120 mA total through JP2; at its minimum duty (18%, pinmap.md) each sink within +-25%; 18<->95% step: no ringing on the scope; a 3.5 V cell at the highest duty: drop <= 5%; USB plugged in while lit: no visible flash

title: BU-3.6 tearing-effect pulse
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md display step 6
pass_limit: one pulse per frame, 60 Hz +-10%

title: BU-4 audio: level, carrier, wake, heat, noise
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 4; scope across SPK_P/SPK_N (two probes, A-B); thermocouple on U7
pass_limit: >= 0.35 W into 8 ohm (>= 4.75 V peak-to-peak) at 1 kHz on a 3.8 V cell; carrier >= 40 dB down; full output <= 150 ms after AMP_EN; U7 top <= 85 C after 10 min full scale on USB; no audible whine in silence

title: BU-5.1 off-state cell current
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.1: DMM across cut JP5 on its A range through turn-on, then the uA range with the device off (or a 0.1 ohm shunt on the scope); the uA range cannot pass the 0.75 A turn-on peak; with VER-146's TP1 reading
pass_limit: <= 30 uA at 25 C, cell 3.7-4.2 V, device off, no USB (designed: R17 into U10's clamped input about 7.9 uA at a 4.2 V cell since 71737ae, 4.5 uA through the 940k divider before; U2 from BAT, U7 in shutdown on the live VSYS, U3 off)

title: BU-5.2 charge current and CHG_OFF pause
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.2: DMM on its A range across cut JP5; log the current for 10 min at the start of CC with a thermocouple on U2's top (a voided exposed pad shows the current sliding as U2 passes 70 C: DF-08)
pass_limit: 242-295 mA into a cell at 3.6-3.9 V (R5 3.3k) and still >= 242 mA after 10 min with U2's top under ambient + 50 C; CHG_OFF high stops it within 1 s; low resumes

title: BU-5.3 ADC against a meter; CV at charge-done; bench-supply sweep
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.3; then the bench supply in place of the cell, 3.0-4.2 V in 0.1 V steps, with CHG_OFF (GPIO43) held high or 10 ohm 5 W across the supply (most supplies cannot sink U2's 242-295 mA); record VBAT at each point
pass_limit: computed VBAT within 20 mV of the DMM at 3.50 V after calibration (VER-155) and within 50 mV elsewhere above 3.6 V; VBAT 4.158-4.242 V when CHG_STAT_N goes high at the end of a charge
instrument: handheld DMM, 0.5% + 2 counts; checked against the 4.096 V reference that session
needs: 10 ohm 5 W resistor and a 4.096 V reference breakout (LM4040 or REF3040, about $3, 7d)

title: BU-5.4 charger heat and the TS level
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.4 (thermocouple on U2; DMM on TP7, the TS node)
pass_limit: TS within design_numbers.py tsband's band at the ambient read beside the board (about 0.70-1.04 V at 22 C; 0.75 V nominal holds only at 25 C: round 2's objection); after 10 min of charging in the closed case still >= 0.46 V (TH1 under 35 C: B4460 at 75 uA, 6.15 kohm); U2's top under ambient + 50 C

title: BU-5.4a charge pauses outside the temperature window
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.4a on unit 1 only (hair dryer, cold pack, thermocouple next to TH1); VER-135 is the per-unit TS check
pass_limit: pauses at VER-32's hot edge +-3 C rising (47 C nominal) and its cold edge +-3 C falling (3.5 C nominal); resumes in range

title: BU-5.5 unplug on the scope; 100 unplugs with a flash check
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.5; scope on TP4 (3V3) and TP2 (VSYS); the bench supply as the cell at 3.50 V with CHG_OFF held high or 10 ohm 5 W across it, so it stays at 3.50 V while USB is in; record VBAT at the trigger instant
pass_limit: VBAT at the trigger 3.50 +-0.03 V; VSYS never below VBAT - 0.10 V; 3V3 >= 3.135 V throughout; 100 unplugs with no reset and no flash CRC error

title: BU-5.6 hot plug with no cell
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.6 (A-to-C cable from an always-on USB-A port)
pass_limit: VBUS at or under U2's OVP minimum less 0.2 V (as VER-12); VSYS <= 4.6 V; EN1 (U2 pin 6) <= 6.7 V; PWR_EN (TP6) <= 5.5 V; bringup.md step 5.6 to match (DEF-21)

title: BU-5.7 U3's EN at a live plug-in
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 5.7 (scope TP6 PWR_EN and TP2, cell in, board off)
pass_limit: PWR_EN <= 5.5 V at every instant (the RT9013's EN, 6 V absolute), 10 plug-ins

title: BU-6 power switch: on, latch, off, reset
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/bringup.md step 6 (bringup.md 6.2-6.3 still say Y: DEF-21)
pass_limit: on only after Start held 1.0 +-0.2 s; off after a long press; RESET turns it off on the cell; off current back <= 30 uA

title: First power with JP1 cut (catch a wrong LDO before it reaches the chip)
procedure: add to bringup.md step 1: unit 1 with JP1 cut, USB through a 100 mA limit, DMM on 3V3_LDO; then bridge JP1
pass_limit: 3V3_LDO 3.20-3.40 V before JP1 is bridged

title: Chip identity and stepping, logged per unit
procedure: picotool info -a (chip ID, package, stepping, flash JEDEC ID) at first boot; write it to the unit's record
pass_limit: RP2354B, 2 MB flash; stepping recorded (A2 means E9 applies to AMP_EN and BL_PWM)

title: Production self-test image
procedure: write a self-test UF2 on the generated pin file (VER-149): buttons; a GPIO neighbour-bridge test whose pair table is generated from design.GPIO_PIN, marking each pin safe to toggle or not (PWR_HOLD, CHG_OFF, AMP_EN, BL_PWM, the QSPI pins), using the external pull's direction where one exists, on USB power only, and cross-checked against hardware/vv/bridges.csv (VER-148); panel ID and fills; backlight; audio tone; ADC; charger states incl. the 2 Hz fault; the 16-bit shift-register read; no OTP or flash-security writes
pass_limit: every item PASS on a good unit and FAIL on a seeded fault (a shorted button, a panel unplugged); every 'caught by self-test' pair in bridges.csv is in its pair table; <= 5 min a unit

title: PWR_HOLD release after reset and crash on the real board
procedure: scope PWR_HOLD at U4 pin 55 (GPIO44; it has no pad: probe D2 pin 2 or R42), TP6 (PWR_EN) and TP4 (+3V3) through RESET, a watchdog reset and a hard fault, on the cell
pass_limit: PWR_HOLD < 0.5 V within 10 ms; 3V3 < 0.5 V within 200 ms of Start released

title: Start with 1 kohm in series still turns the device on (both Start domes)
procedure: 1 kohm in series with each Start dome in turn (SW21, then SW23: across its pads in place of a press); bench supply as the cell at 3.50 V
pass_limit: for each dome: 3V3 >= 3.20 V within 50 ms; PWR_BTN_N (SW21) or P2_START (SW23) reads low; Q1's or Q7's gate margin over its maximum Vgs(th) (q1.json) reported in volts

title: Start leakage immunity and per-unit dome leakage (both Start domes)
procedure: 1 Mohm across SW21's pads, then across SW23's, cell at 4.2 V, no USB; then each unit's leakage from the VSYS ring to the centre pad of both domes as VER-46
pass_limit: the device stays off (3V3 < 0.5 V) for 10 min with either; every unit's SW21 and SW23 >= 100 Mohm

title: USB sources, cables and orientations
procedure: both plug orientations on a USB-C charger, a PD charger, an A-to-C cable from a PC and from a hub, the bench supply at a 500 mA limit; 5 cables. Characterisation (recorded, not pass/fail: REQ-PWR-01, REQ-PWR-16): bench supply into VBUS through a USB-C breakout at 4.40 V and 4.60 V, backlight full, DMM across cut JP5 at CV: U2's VIN-DPM (4.5 V): the input current it takes and whether the cell supplements the system
pass_limit: charges and enumerates in both orientations on every source; no limit cycling at 500 mA; every cable seats fully, case closed
needs: USB-C breakout (about $5, 5d) and a PD charger (owned?)

title: Input current from a default-power USB port
procedure: USB power meter between a PC's USB-A port and the device, charging a flat cell with the backlight at 100%
pass_limit: input current <= 500 mA within 2 s of plug-in from a default-power port (U2's USB500 limit, 475 mA), the backlight at full and a flat cell charging

title: Charge path after charge-done plus 1 h (unit 1 confirmation)
procedure: unit 1, after VER-133 and VER-169 pass: a real cell charged to done with USB in, then 1 h more; DMM on TP3; DMM across cut JP5 for 1 min at the end
pass_limit: VBAT <= 4.242 V after 1 h at charge-done; the cell current 0 to -5 mA (U2 off the cell until VBAT falls 100 mV, then a top-up)

title: 3V3 regulation and 3V3 load
procedure: bench supply into VBUS (USB-C breakout) and as the cell 3.6-4.2 V; DMM on mA across cut JP1 at idle and at the self-test's heaviest load
pass_limit: 3V3 3.20-3.40 V at every point; 3V3 load <= 150 mA

title: 1V1 core rail level and ripple
procedure: scope on TP9 (1V1), 20 MHz limit, ground spring, at idle and at full CPU load
pass_limit: within the RP2350's DVDD range (Table 1688: write the values into this row on first use) including ripple

title: Cell surface temperature over a full charge in the closed case
procedure: attended, in a LiPo bag on a tile (VER-172); K-type thermocouple taped to the cell (a DMM with a thermocouple input, about $25 if not owned); log every minute; 25 C room, then a 35 C box
pass_limit: <= 45 C at 25 C ambient; <= the cell maker's charge maximum at 35 C
needs: DMM with thermocouple input (about $25, 2d)

title: Touch temperature during charge-while-playing
procedure: the firmware rule from VER-144 in the image first; thermocouples on the face over U2, the back over U7 and the hottest spot found by touch; 1 h charge-while-playing, backlight 100%, audio full scale
pass_limit: <= 43 C (target) at 25 C ambient; measured rise + the rated maximum ambient <= 48 C (IEC 62368-1 TS1 limit for plastic held 10 min to 8 h)

title: TH1 tracks the cell during charge
procedure: two thermocouples: one at the cell's centre and one on its end facing TH1; TH1 from the TS voltage (VER-68); one full charge in the closed case
pass_limit: TH1 within 5 C of the cell's hotter point throughout
needs: a second thermocouple (about $3, 7d)

title: Cell protection (PCM) trip test on a spare pack
procedure: bench supply into the pack: raise to find OVP, discharge through a resistor to find UVP, short through 0.1 ohm for OCP
pass_limit: OVP 4.25-4.35 V; UVP 2.4-3.0 V; OCP trips (or the spec sheet's values) on one pack per lot

title: Assembled-board inspection under the microscope (IPC-A-610 Class 2)
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md section 3.2 extended: U4's QFN-80 edges; U2's VQFN-16 with BAT pins 2 and 3 against the exposed pad (DF-148) and the ISET 16 / TS 1 corner (DF-146); J3's FH12-50 at 0.5 mm pitch; U8 and U9 (TSSOP-16); the SOIC-8s (U6, U7); the SOT-23, SOT-23-5 (U10 since 71737ae) and SOT-23-6 leads; TH1 (0805 since 71737ae); the SOD-323s; the 0402s and the 4 x 0402 arrays RN1-RN4; J1's pin row; J2 (PicoBlade), J4 (JST SH, 1.0 mm, since 71737ae) and J5; the bare SW20-SW23 dome pads and their vents; every pin 1 against the silk; the 1.0 mm FR4 rim between the speaker's hole and the board's right edge, uncracked (DF-178)
pass_limit: no bridge, tombstone, lifted lead or missing part; every pin 1 as the silk; every unit
subsystems: power cell mcu display audio buttons usb_debug

title: Board flatness on arrival
procedure: board on a glass plate, feeler gauges (about $5) at the corners
pass_limit: bow and twist <= 0.75% of the board's length: 1.14 mm over 151.64 mm (case.scad board_l; the Edge.Cuts outline)

title: Hand assembly demo and time study
procedure: hardware/ref_design/docs/assembly.md sections 3-5 on one unit, timed, ESD mat and strap (about $15); no iron: nothing is soldered at assembly; record the step order: J3 latched, the cell into the tub's pocket, J2 then J4 plugged; on opening, J2 unplugged before the tub lifts away (DF-169, DF-170, DEF-41)
pass_limit: one unit in <= 30 min with a screwdriver and a knife; no part damaged; no connector mated or unmated with the tub lifting the cell's leads; the cell plug never offered to J4; cell and panel each swap in <= 10 min
needs: ESD mat and strap (about $15, 2d)

title: Case open/close cycling
procedure: 20 open/close cycles with the six screws at the length VER-147 sets, as assembly.md step 8; the case closed with the cell unplugged; after the cycles: C53 (the MLCC nearest a boss) at 40x and TP4 to GND re-measured
pass_limit: no cracked key or grip rib and no stripped boss; the top still seats; C53 (the MLCC nearest a boss, 11.4 mm from H5) uncracked and TP4 > 1 kohm; the evidence names the case release hash

title: Drop test
procedure: unit 4 (sacrificial, gates.md allocation): 3 drops from 1.0 m onto hardwood on the face, an end and a corner (IEC 62368-1 Annex T.7, to confirm); re-run on the DVT spin when a change record asks
pass_limit: still works; no crack that exposes the cell or a board; cell moved <= 1 mm; plug and FPC still seated

title: Button life cycling
procedure: unit 4 or a bare board in a printed case: a hobby servo and a Pico press one button of each type (about $10 of parts)
pass_limit: 100,000 presses with contact resistance staying < 1 kohm
needs: hobby servo and a Pico (about $10, 7d)

title: ESD screen on unit 4 (piezo igniter)
procedure: unit 4: a piezo lighter igniter (about $3, uncalibrated, about 10 kV) at each cap gap (comb pads first), the seams and the USB-C shell, 10 zaps each; the calibrated test is VER-170 on the DVT spin
pass_limit: no damage; recovers by itself or by a power cycle; any dead input or latch-up named for the DVT fix (0402 series-resistor footprints on the button nets and SW21)

procedure: write hardware/vv/tools/release.py: refuse a dirty tree, and refuse to build fab files when any DESIGN_PATHS blob differs from README's design baseline; at the tagged commit rebuild the board twice from design.py with route.py --reuse, which replays the committed board/tools/last_route.ses instead of a fresh Freerouting race (route.py runs up to 8 seeded attempts and keeps the first clean one, so a plain rebuild gives new copper: O-S2, F-S2), then the maze, pour and stitching steps as tools/build.py runs them; re-run the DRC; diff the two rebuilds with each other and with the committed battler.kicad_pcb, the dated lines stripped (62b01f2 moved a GND via by hand: O-R10, DEF-60); then run fab.py --no-pictures twice and compare the gerbers and drill files with TF.CreationDate and the Excellon date header stripped (was VER-24), check_bom_cpl, check_fab_content, the drill check and every scripted check; write evidence with the zip's, BOM's and CPL's sha256, case/positions.json's sha256 (gitignored, so not in the baseline) and the KiCad, OpenSCAD and Python versions; fill the EVT release record
pass_limit: exits 0 at a clean tag; the record's sha256 equals the uploaded zip's; every scripted check's evidence names that commit; the two fab runs' copper and drill files identical once dated lines are stripped; the two --reuse rebuilds identical to each other and to the committed board's copper once dated lines are stripped (no hand edit survives a rebuild). If the first run shows --reuse is not repeatable, the limit becomes: every footprint's position and rotation, the netlist's connectivity (kicad-cli) and DRC 0 errors and 0 unconnected equal on the committed board and a rebuild, and that change is recorded in PLAN.md (O-S2)
subsystems: power cell mcu display audio buttons usb_debug register

title: Dissipation per mode with positions; the firmware heat rule
procedure: a table per mode (off, cell play, USB play, charging, charging while playing) of each part's dissipation and position: U2 up to about 0.66 W ((5.0 - 4.4) V x 475 mA + (4.4 - 3.0) V x 270 mA), U7 up to about 0.4 W, Q5/Q6 about 0.1 W together, U3 about 0.17 W; U2's junction through its pad; from it a firmware rule written in pinmap.md (for example CHG_OFF or capped volume while the backlight is at full on USB)
pass_limit: the table written with each mode's total; U2's junction under its thermal regulation point in a 40 C case; U2, U3, U7, Q5 and Q6 each at or under its junction maximum less 20 C at 40 C ambient in the worst mode, each thermal resistance quoted from a datasheet with its line; the firmware rule in pinmap.md before VER-86 runs

title: The charger's safety timer and its fault on screen
procedure: unit 1, no cell: the load of VER-134 in the cell's place (160 ohm in parallel with the TL431 branch) keeps U2 in CV, so it never terminates; leave USB in for 6.5 h (SLUS810N's tMAXCHG with TMR open is 4-6 h, bq24074.txt:818, and it runs slower while DPPM or thermal regulation cuts the current); then the self-test reads CHG_STAT_N
pass_limit: CHG_STAT_N at 2 Hz by 6 h from the start (U2's fast-charge timer, TMR open: 4-6 h) and the time it started flashing recorded; the firmware shows a charge fault until USB is re-plugged
needs: the VER-134 load parts (about $3, LCSC, 7d)

title: Off-state current at 45 C (warm box)

pass_limit: at 45 C the JP5 current within REQ-PWR-07's 45 C limit (60 uA); at 60 C PWR_EN low and the device off

pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: bom.md's Screws line names every screw length case.scad uses; the side screws (H1-H4) 4.0 mm or more of thread above the board, their tip 0.5 mm or more short of the pilot's end; the end screws (H5, H6) 3.0 mm or more and 0.1 mm short (REQ-MEC-09; fails today: M2 x 6 gives the side screws 3.2 mm; M2 x 7 there passes)

title: Usable cell capacity per lot
procedure: one cell per lot: charge from the bench supply at 4.20 V with a 0.35 A limit (a CC/CV charger) until the current falls to 36 mA; discharge at about 140 mA through 27 ohm 2 W (or a ZB2L3-style tester), logging the voltage every minute

pass_limit: the panel still bonded; no mura; no new contact marks on the panel's back; the tape's part number in the release record

title: VBAT gain calibration per unit at 3.50 V
procedure: production test: no USB, the bench supply into J2 at 3.50 V, the self-test at its highest 3V3 load; a DMM checked that session against the 4.096 V reference; the firmware stores true / reading; record the raw ADC count, the DMM value and the gain in evidence/unit-<serial>.csv

title: Test access for every per-unit screen (check_test_access.py)

title: Back-power path table (check_backpower.py)
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/check_backpower.py over design.py's parts and nets: five power states (off on the cell; on the cell with no USB; the plug-in before 3V3 rises; off with the Debug Probe on J5; on with JP4 cut), each with its live rails and the nets a powered part or an outside source drives (the RP2350's GPIO, SWD and its USB D+ pull-up, rp2350.txt:101220); liveness spreads through resistors, bridged jumpers, L2, TH1 and forward diodes but never into a rail; an input of U1, U2's input-side pins, U4, U6, U7, U8, U9, U10 or the panel on a live net while its own supply is dead is a path; each needs a line in the script's ACCEPTED table with its worst-case current and DFMEA row; --seed moves U1's REF (pin 5) to VBUS (DEF-01) and must fail; at ORDER Alex reads the paths by hand (F-R2(c))
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: exit 0, every path listed with its current, and the seeded DEF-01 fails (passes at 71737ae: 20 paths in 9 table lines: R17 into U10's input whenever 3V3 is off, about 6.8 uA; R9/R10 into U2's PGOOD and CHG and GPIO43 into its CE with VBUS at 0; CC1/CC2 through R3/R4 into GPIO45/46 for about 1 ms at plug-in; the probe's SWCLK and SWDIO into an unpowered U4; the RP2350's outputs into the panel with JP4 cut. U1 is not a path: nothing drives D+ or D- while 3V3 is off)

title: Charge current and window tied to the cell (cell.json)
procedure: hardware/ref_design/board/cell.json (model, capacity, standard charge current, charge temperature range, PCM values) filled from VER-37; case.scad's cell numbers and a power-analysis script read it and assert; moved to EVT on 2026-10-27 (round 3's O-S6): the only value the order freezes is R5's, and VER-37's spec sheet checks it against the cell before the order (REQ-BAT-02.R)

The dome's own rule against the dome's drawing is VER-178's

pass_limit: every field filled; VER-48 and VER-92 evidence names the hash

procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py cpl: imports board/tools/fab.py, points its OUT at a temp dir, runs its own bom_cpl(), reads the battler_cpl_jlc.csv it writes and compares every row's Mid X and -Mid Y with that footprint's pad bounding-box centre (pcbnew). A word in fab.py cannot pass it (seeded in VER-129)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: every CPL row within 0.10 mm of its pads' centre, unless the ref has a JLC correction recorded in design_numbers.py's JLC_FIXED with the dry run's screenshot (none today. Passes at 71737ae: fab.py writes each footprint's pads' centre since 40281b8, 120 rows, none over 0.10 mm; at be437f8 it failed: J1 1.50 mm, J2 0.95, J4 0.95, J3 0.23. Whether JLC's own library origins agree is the placement preview's, VER-28: O-R7)

title: VBUS fault reach: the lowest VBUS that over-stresses a part

pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: no part over its absolute maximum for VBUS up to 20 V, the highest fixed USB PD voltage a broken source may put out (fails at 71737ae: U3's EN at 9.1 V with R14 47k, U2's EN1 at 12.4 V with R43 220k; it was 6.9 V with R14 10k. EN1 still reads high down to VBUS 3.6 V at SLUS810N's 10 uA input current at 1.4 V, bq24074.txt:848-850); binding at G-EVT-04: DEC-17 is decided before the order through DEF-50 (O-R9)

title: Dome footprint against the 4 mm dome's drawing (Dome_4mm_Round)
procedure: write a check beside check_contact_fp.py: the HYP 600-415S-260 drawing's rim and centre against Dome_4mm_Round.kicad_mod's ring, centre pad, gap and mask (fp_dome.py draws it), and the Kapton dot's size against the pads; since 71737ae the centre pad is 1.2 mm (1.6 before) and the vent sits at r 1.15, 0.30 mm from both pads (DEF-56's hole rule), so the dimple's contact is checked at the hand placement's 0.3 mm
pass_limit: the dome's rim lands on the ring all round with 0.2 mm or more to spare at 0.1 mm of placement error; the dimple's contact inside the 1.2 mm centre pad at 0.3 mm of placement error; 0.20 mm or more copper gap; no paste or silk on the pads

title: SR_CLK integrity at U9 and a million button reads
procedure: unit 1: scope SR_CLK at U9 pin 2 and U8 pin 2 (10x probe, short ground spring) with the backlight at 100% and audio playing; the self-test reads the chain 1,000,000 times at its clock with every contact released, then with a pattern of pressed contacts held by tape
pass_limit: one monotonic edge per clock at both registers (no step or ring crossing 0.9-2.3 V twice); 0 read errors in 1,000,000 reads in both patterns

title: Start/Select strip's plunger against the dome at rest
procedure: calipers on two Start/Select strips: each plunger's height g under the strip's datum; then ss_lift in case.scad set to 0.35 + max(0, 0.36 - g) as hardware/ref_design/PLAN.md says, and case.scad's two dome asserts re-run
pass_limit: the plunger clears the dome's apex at rest by 0.05 mm or more at the measured g; the dome closes when the cap is pressed through its travel
needs: calipers (about $15, 2d) and two Start/Select strips (AliExpress, 21d)

title: Cell gap on every side: a worst-case cell to the routed FR4 edge, after tolerances
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py cellgap: case.scad's cell_hole and the tub's pocket (cell_pocket_box since 71737ae: 0.9 mm inside the hole on the long sides and the seat-1 end, 1.9 mm at the lead end; cell_pocket_fit all round before), the worst-case and nominal cells; the gap on every face is at least the pocket's inset there, less JLC's routing tolerance, the print's wall tolerance and the board's float on its screws; and the cell's fit in the pocket (round 3's O-S1): the pocket, printed 0.1 mm small on each side, must still exceed the cell by 0.1 mm a side; it prints what would pass (the largest cell for this hole, the smallest hole for the worst-case cell)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: >= 0.5 mm from a worst-case cell to the routed FR4 edge on every face (1.5 mm at its lead end) after tolerances (REQ-BAT-08), and the pocket at least 0.4 mm longer and wider than the cell (0.1 mm print and 0.1 mm fit a side, REQ-BAT-08 as proposed on 2026-10-27) (fails at 71737ae on the fit alone: every gap is exactly met, 0.50 mm and 1.50 mm, but the pocket is 52.00 x 36.00 mm, the worst-case cell's own size, so 0.00 mm spare against 0.40; this hole takes a cell of at most 51.60 x 35.60 mm, and the worst-case 52 x 36 cell needs a 55.20 x 38.20 mm hole. At be437f8 the gaps failed: -0.15 mm and 1.35 mm)

title: Free height above a worst-case cell (swelling room)
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/design_numbers.py swell: the free height above a worst-case cell under whatever case.scad puts over the tub's pocket (the panel's back, the panel frame's walls, the ends' underside, the screen band's underside; split from VER-20, O-R21)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: >= 0.4 mm of free height above a worst-case 4.5 mm cell (10% of the nominal 4.0 mm) under everything over its pocket (0.80 mm under the panel's back at 71737ae, as at be437f8; over the cell's seat-2 end, past the panel's frame, the slope's inside stands 3.40 mm over the board, 1.80 mm free: case.scad's uni_ceil, which design_numbers.py now reads, 2026-10-27, instead of the old decks' joint line)

title: prod_board: pill resistance and ring leakage on a bare board
procedure: on a bare prod_board from Alex's order: a DS Lite pill pressed on each of SW1-SW16 at 1 N, DMM on ohms; then 4.2 V through each contact's rings into a DMM on volts (10 Mohm input), clean and after a damp-cloth wipe, as VER-45 and VER-46
pass_limit: every contact under 1 kohm pressed; every ring pair >= 100 Mohm (DMM reads <= 0.38 V)
needs: a bare prod_board from Alex's order, 14d

title: J2 and J4 keyed apart: the cell's plug cannot enter the speaker's header

title: Flash map and the size check in scripts/check.sh
procedure: the flash map (image, settings, battle log) written into the evidence, with the sizes it accounts for; a size check in scripts/check.sh that fails when the image grows past the limit REQ-MCU-10 names; the llvm-size figure itself is VER-151's, at ORDER (F-R2(f))
pass_limit: the flash map written and cited by the size check; scripts/check.sh fails on a release build over the limit

pass_limit: 0 unexplained differences between design.py and the LCSC record for every line

title: Copied core diff script against Raspberry Pi's RP2350B minimal design
procedure: write board/tools/check_core.py: netlist and geometry diff of the copied core (pads, vias, VREG_LX copper, decoupling) against RP-010329; the by-hand overlay at ORDER is VER-23's
pass_limit: 0 unexplained differences; the second 4.7 uF on +1V1 question answered in writing

title: No live row names a part, part number or net design.py no longer has (stale_names.py)
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/stale_names.py: reads design.py at the baseline commit README names and every earlier design.py on its history; lists each reference designator, net (with an underscore or a digit) and part-number stem that left; scans every live row of requirements.md, dfmea.csv and verification.csv outside 'Was: ...' clauses. check_trace.py's default mode runs the same scan, so a row written after this evidence fails the register's structure at once
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: 0 live rows name a part, part number or net absent from design.py at the baseline (12 rows did on 2026-10-27, before this check: the commit that added it rewrote them)

title: Requirements review per subsystem: every function has a requirement with a number, a source and a check
procedure: for each subsystem of grid.md, list its functions from design.py's sheets and the case (power: take USB, charge, regulate VSYS and 3V3, latch on and off; cell: hold, sense and protect the cell; mcu: boot, clock, run, reset, store; display: drive the panel and its backlight; audio: play; buttons: read 20 contacts; usb_debug: enumerate, flash and debug over USB and SWD; case: hold, protect, open and cool), then read every live requirement against the list; save the table with WHO and ARTEFACT (requirements.md's blob hash)
pass_limit: 0 functions without a requirement; 0 live requirements without a number and tolerance, a primary Source (a datasheet line, a standard's clause or Alex's decision) and a live check; each finding logged as a new requirement or a DEF
subsystems: power cell mcu display audio buttons usb_debug case

title: Case architecture against its requirements: each case-side requirement met by a named feature
procedure: map each case-side requirement (REQ-MEC-*, REQ-PRD-06, REQ-ASM-*, REQ-BAT-07 and REQ-BAT-08, the case items of REQ-BTN-*) to the case.scad module and the number from its echo that meets it at nominal; walk assembly.md's order step by step and name what holds each part in the closed case (the board on its six screws, the cell in the tub's pocket, the panel in the top, the speaker, the silicone); before the order because the board's outline, holes and positions come from the case (positions.json)
pass_limit: every case-side requirement mapped to a feature and a number that meets it; 0 unmapped; every part held by a feature of the case, not by tape (DEF-58's stop for the cell named)

title: USB data path values at their tolerance corners (R21, R22, U1)
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/paper_checks.py usb: R21 and R22 (27 ohm 1%) at both corners against the 27 ohm series termination the RP2350 requires (rp2350.txt:1196); rp2350.pdf gives no output impedance for its PHY, so ZDRV's sum rests on that figure; the capacitance on D+ and D- to ground from the routed tracks (pcbnew; 0.1 pF/mm and 0.5 pF a via, stand-ins), U1 (5 pF max, u1.json p2; srv05-4.pdf not on disk) and the RP2350's pad (10 pF, a stand-in: its datasheet gives none), with the margin printed; --seed moves R21 to 22 ohm and must fail
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: R21 and R22 contain the RP2350's required 27 ohm at both 1% corners (the source impedance within ZDRV's 28-44 ohm is Raspberry Pi's figure: the PHY's share is not in rp2350.pdf); D+ and D- each at or under 100 pF to ground, the RP2350's pad, U1 and the track together (CINUB, an upstream facing port without its cable, USB 2.0 Table 7-7; the README's note on clauses quoted from memory applies); each constant quoted from a file with its line or named a stand-in (passes at 71737ae: 26.73-27.27 ohm; D+ 23.4 pF, D- 22.1 pF, a 92 pF margin for U1 and the pad)

title: Case material temperature rating against its hottest inner surface
procedure: the printed material's heat deflection temperature at 0.45 MPa from its datasheet (VER-173 names the material and brand) against the case's hottest inner surface from VER-193 at 40 C ambient, in the worst mode (charging while playing, backlight full); the spots over U2, U7 and the cell first; VER-193 runs first: it is an ORDER check and this one takes its number
pass_limit: the heat deflection temperature at least 15 C above the hottest inner surface; the material's datasheet saved with its sha256

title: Board-wide dissipation on paper: every part, the cell's own heat and the case's inner surface
procedure: extend VER-144's table to every part it leaves out: U4 at full CPU with its core regulator through L2, U8 and U9 at the scan clock, U1, U6, the pull-up arrays, the cell's own I squared R at 0.75 A with its ESR from VER-37, and J1 at 0.5 A; each part's temperature rise from its package's thermal resistance in its datasheet; the case's inner surface over the hottest parts handed to VER-192
pass_limit: every part's junction at or under its maximum less 20 C at 40 C ambient in the worst mode; the cell's surface at or under 45 C charging while playing at 25 C ambient; each thermal resistance quoted from a datasheet with its line

title: Flash endurance and retention for the settings and the battle log
procedure: from the flash map (VER-185): the settings' and the battle log's writes a day, the sector erases they cost (with the firmware's wear levelling, or without if it has none), against the RP2354B's in-package flash erase cycles and retention from its datasheet, quoted with file and line, over 3 years of daily play
pass_limit: >= 10 x margin on erase cycles over 3 years of 4 h a day; retention at 45 C at least the datasheet's figure the firmware relies on, written in pinmap.md

title: USB connector fault reach: VBUS on CC1, CC2, D+ and D-
procedure: add 'usbfault' to design_numbers.py beside vbus (VER-177): with VBUS up to 20 V on each of J1's CC and data pins (a broken source, or a bridge on J1's row: DF-51), the voltage and current at every part on the path: R3 and R4 into CC1_SENSE and CC2_SENSE (U4 pins 57 and 56), R21 and R22 into USB_DP_MCU and USB_DM_MCU, U1 (SRV05-4) pins 1 and 3 clamping into +3V3 through pin 5, and what +3V3 does with that current while the LDO holds it; each absolute maximum and the RP2350's pad limits quoted from the datasheet with file and line (rp2350.txt; the SRV05-4's datasheet saved beside it first and hashed by datasheet_hashes.py)
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: no part on those paths over its absolute maximum, steady or for 1 s, for VBUS up to 20 V (PD_MAX) on any of J1's A5, B5, A6, A7, B6 or B7; each part that is over named with its margin, for DEC-17
needs: the SRV05-4's datasheet (LCSC's product page, 0d)

title: Audio amplifier states on paper: U7 shut down at power-up, reset, sleep and off
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/paper_checks.py ampstate: AMP_EN (U4 pin 43) held by R37 (100k, +1%) against the pad's 1 uA leakage maximum (rp2350.txt:101100), so Q3's gate against its 1.0 V minimum VGS(th) (q1.json p2; the 2N7002's datasheet is not on disk); for each state (off with VSYS live, power-up before firmware, RESET, a watchdog reset, sleep, USB in with the cell flat) the pad's reset state (PADS_BANK0 IE 0, PDE 1, ISO 1, rp2350.txt:59412-59433; E9 not after a PoR or RUN reset, 102952; the watchdog's PSM WDSEL, 36739-36791); AMP_SHDN against VDD for VSYS 3.0-4.4 V with Q3's off leakage (1 uA stand-in), against the 'supply voltage' the FM8002A names for shutdown (u7.json pin 1; fm8002a.pdf not on disk, and it prints no VIH: limit 95% of VDD); U7's shutdown current (2 x its 4.2 uA typical) and R36's added to the off budget (shelf, VER-103); --seed makes R37 1 Mohm and must fail
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: U7 shut down in every state except the firmware driving AMP_EN high, for VSYS 3.0-4.4 V at every corner, with Q3's gate at least 0.4 V under its minimum VGS(th); U7's shutdown current and R36's together leave the off current within 30 uA (VER-73's limit); each threshold quoted from a datasheet with its line, or named as from pin_review where the datasheet is not on disk (passes at 71737ae: gate 0.10 V, 0.90 V under 1.0 V; AMP_SHDN within 0.10 V of VDD; off budget 27.3 uA; two firmware rules, analysis/errata_rp2350.md)
needs: the FM8002A's and the 2N7002's datasheets on disk to confirm u7.json's and q1.json's figures (VER-34; LCSC C94625 and C8545), 0d

title: Core values against rp2350.pdf's own rules (VREG, DVDD and IOVDD decoupling, crystal load, AVDD filter)
procedure: python3 hardware/vv/tools/paper_checks.py core: design.py's C24, C25, L2, R19, C26, X1, C27, C28, R21 and R22 against rp2350.pdf's component rules (rp2350.txt:33598-33612, 33281-33290, 40927-40950, 1196); then on the routed board (pcbnew) the capacitor nearest each DVDD, IOVDD, ADC_AVDD, USB_OTP_VDD and QSPI_IOVDD pin of U4, pad centre to pad centre: the two DVDD pins nearest VREG_LX want 100 nF close and the furthest 4.7 uF (rp2350.txt:32665-32675), ADC_AVDD and USB_OTP_VDD 100 nF close (32705, 32686); 'close' is read as 5 mm (Raspberry Pi's layout puts its 0402s 1-3 mm away); --seed makes C25 1 uF and must fail. The answer to VER-23's second-4.7 uF question from the datasheet itself, while RP-010329 is not on disk
pass_limit: RESULT: PASS: C24 >= 4.7 uF; C25 4.7 uF +-20%; L2 3.3 uH, the recommended AOTA-B201610S3R3-101-T; R19 and C26 33 ohm and 4.7 uF; X1 the ABM8-272-T3 with C27 and C28 giving CL 10 +-2.5 pF at 2-5 pF stray; R21 and R22 27 ohm; every DVDD, IOVDD, ADC_AVDD, USB_OTP_VDD and QSPI_IOVDD pin with a capacitor of the value the datasheet names within 5 mm (fails at 71737ae: DVDD pin 51's nearest +1V1 capacitor is C25 at 7.2 mm, C22 sits 15 mm away; DVDD pin 32, the furthest, has C21 100 nF and no 4.7 uF, C25 is 12 mm away; IOVDD pins 41 and 50 have none within 5 mm (the nearest at 7.4 and 6.7 mm), their own C17 and C15 sit about 10 mm away)
